questions.q: What is the value of the 6 in 5,264?
questions.why: The 6 is in the tens place (5 thousands, 2 hundreds, 6 tens, 4 ones). 6 × 10 = 60.

questions.q: What is the value of the 4 in 0.143?
questions.why: The first digit after the point is tenths, the second is hundredths. The 4 is in the hundredths place: 4 × 0.01 = 0.04.

questions.q: What digit is in the hundredths place of 7.926?
questions.why: Count right from the point: tenths (9), then hundredths (2).
Write 0.6 as 0.60. Compare 60 hundredths with 58 hundredths: 60 is more.
The tenths digit is 6. Next door is 2, so it stays. Answer: 5.6.
